<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 180.0423, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈10 % of base) indicates roughly nine carbon atoms. The formula that best fits this mass and the observed isotopic distribution, while containing only C, H, O, and a single hetero atom (X), is C₉H₉NO₃. This matches the required format.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9NO3</final_answer>
